values.name: Tolerance
values.text: We live in a diverse country, and that asks us to be tolerant: to understand that people may differ from us in opinion, gender, income and religion. We emphasise listening to differing opinions and keeping an open mind.

values.name: Equality
values.text: Our decisions are free of discrimination based on gender, income, religion or social status. We believe everyone deserves an equal opportunity, and we instil this value in our students for a more inclusive future.

values.name: Merit
values.text: Merit is the sole criterion in our decisions, from selecting teachers and staff to admitting and evaluating students.

values.name: Character Building
values.text: Character building is integral to our work, because we are raising the next generation of this country: individuals who put humanity first and respect others.
